The original plan

The Joyful Responsible Abundance Product Engine, Luke Nathan Hayes, 28 September 2026. 21 pages.

The PDF is published with the author’s approval and preserved without editing. This site adapts its explanation for a public audience.

Read the original PDF ↗

About this edition

Public explanation and implementation by Luke Nathan Hayes / Strange But True / Aura of Intelligence, assisted by AI.

All four concept artworks, including the favicon, were generated for this site. They do not depict tested products, operating facilities or confirmed partners.

View the artwork prompts

What works here

CapabilityThis public edition
Product planningBlank records and nine editable case-study presets, with stable references and saved versions.
Costs and continued useTransparent AUD estimates, break-even quantities, return comparisons and receiving-route notes.
Connected workSeveral contributions and product links per record, with terms and source links.
Portable outputsMarkdown release packs and JSON backups, including version snapshots. Backup import restores a workspace.
AI handoffsEditable task scopes and permission status. An optional read-only browser tool exposes the open record where supported.
Commerce and agentsLive agents, payments, orders, stock, shared accounts and external publication are future integrations.

Workbench records stay in the browser on the device where they are entered. There are no site analytics or form submissions. Web fonts are requested from Google Fonts; normal hosting access logs may still exist. If you explicitly use a browser AI tool, the open record is returned to that tool.
